comment: mkobj.c costly_alteration() 790-791 and 813: a debug Valkyrie level-teleports into Pakka Pakka's general store on Dlvl 3 (seed from a port scan of 5520001-5520300 for a ^V arrival in a shop), sells two wished holy waters on a shop square and zaps a wished wand of cancellation down at them: 'You unbless those, you pay for them!' (a stack, 790-791; unblessing makes bknown known, 813). She sells a wished cursed potion of water two squares south, walks back north and zaps south through both piles: 'You uncurse that, you pay for it!'. 822-823 (the hero off a costly square) are not reached: the square she zaps from counts as costly. Finally she stashes her gold in a wished bag, drops it (the keeper credits the gold; she declines to sell the bag, so it is no_charge) and picks it back up: the bag costs nothing but its gold is charged back, so shk.c addtobill() returns at 3541.
